opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.description: The opacity of the bobber overlay when hooked. 0 = invisible, 100 = opaque.

group.label: Icon
group.description: Settings for the icon that appears when you're hooked

size.label: Size
size.description: The size of the icon in pixels

x.label: X Offset
x.description: The X offset from the center of the screen (crosshair) in pixels (positive = right)

y.label: Y Offset
y.description: The Y offset from the center of the screen (crosshair) in pixels (positive = down)
